@Gideon Sato, draft for Mateo's procurement team, from the #inc-vtg-hartford record (2026-08-03, times as posted there):

Hartford gate kiosks incident, Vantorre Hartford plant

- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Gate check-in was affected. Scheduling still worked from the dispatch office.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM).
- Still open: status-page access for Mateo's login ("access denied"). His admin account can open Pemberline Dock and see arrivals. Tracked in INC-4821. Kiosk 2 was left powered on for the vendor's reconnect attempts; the reconnect log went to Odile Brandt.

This is a draft for you to review before sending. I have not sent anything by email.

Posted the draft as a thread reply in #strategic-random, Gideon. Every member of that channel is also in #inc-vtg-hartford, so nothing new went to anyone. Nothing was sent by email.
